create_Net_for_incremental_learning: create a Net module for incremental classifier and representation learning on CIFAR-100 with ResNet18 backbone
run_Net_forward_nearest_neighbor: run the forward pass using nearest neighbor classification on stored exemplars for a given task
run_Net_forward_training: run the forward training pass that masks outputs to predict only classes within the current task
run_Net_observe_with_distillation: run observe to train on a minibatch with cross-entropy loss and knowledge distillation from exemplar memory
run_Net_compute_offsets: run compute_offsets to calculate the class index range for a given task in incremental learning
